keyTips.text: At level 6, enter from unseen angles with the ultimate and fight as a damage drainer beside W.
Aim Crowstorm flanks at tightly grouped teams for full ultimate damage.
Stay damage-focused with picks while ahead, and swap part of the plan to utility and defense while behind.

tips.text: Learn the fast clear well, valuing a clean red-side version most.
Skirmish early beside mid instead of conceding every pre-6 fight.
Before level 6, pick fights where enemy control cannot cut Bountiful Harvest short.
On blue side, skip camps for an available early kill, since one good gank outweighs delayed camp gold.
Recall first for Fated Ashes, then Dark Seal, then tier-one boots.
Delay boot upgrades that stall the damage curve, leaning on Blue Smite speed after the pet upgrade.
Rush Liandry's Torment for health and burn beside sustained damage.
Spike next on Shadowflame, matching its execute line with W damage.
Finish core damage before situational buys unless the game already slides.
Start Zhonya's after Crowstorm begins when focus threatens, surviving the entry while the ultimate keeps burning.
Take Hextech Rocketbelt into hard-to-reach mobiles, and Rylai's Crystal Scepter into less mobile teams.
Buy defense only for clear needs: Spirit Visage into an AP threat while behind, Randuin's into multi-crit, Oblivion Orb when the team needs anti-heal.
Wait out key interruption tools before channeling W or committing the ultimate entry.
Chain the unseen ultimate entry into W drain, then Zhonya's through the counterattack when needed.

itemization.text: Run Dark Harvest with Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos, and Ultimate Hunter, plus Cash Back and Approach Velocity.
Take Flash and Smite, starting with Gustwalker and Dark Seal.
Core Liandry's Torment, Shadowflame, Zhonya's Hourglass, Rabadon's Deathcap, and Void Staff, finishing Shadowflame before situational adds.
Rotate Hextech Rocketbelt, Rylai's, Bloodletter's Curse, Spirit Visage, Randuin's, and Oblivion Orb by matchup.
